review.gallery: Nine matched native developer renders from the 33-page official brochure. The dusk card and hero show the whole Titania tower.
review.location: Physical page 17 has the named Titania marker and range bands. The local area map on page 16 and the official website did not establish exact times or verified coordinates.
review.floorPlans: All nine apartment types and area tables visually read in official physical pages 22–27. The published studio 02 total is 567 sq ft, while its printed 314 and 235 sq ft parts sum to 549. Its 52.69 sq m total agrees with approximately 567 sq ft. The printed total is retained. Four amenity and typical residential sheets and one original consultant ground-floor sheet are included. The bldubai plan pack repeats the same residential layouts.

unavailable: Individual destination travel times and verified entrance coordinates were not established. A separate three-bedroom plan was not supported by the developer brochure.
